# OpenClaw Mac AI Workstation Setup & Speed-to-Lead Pilot by Igor Ganapolsky

This site provides OpenClaw, a Mac AI workstation setup and autonomous speed-to-lead responder pilot for agencies, SaaS teams, and freelancers to scale lead engagement and payments operations.

## Technology and Approach
- Production-grade Agentic RAG and LLM evaluation harnesses to prevent model drift and keep accuracy high.
- Pre-action safety check mechanisms (gated via ThumbGate PreToolUse hooks) to avoid hallucinated or destructive actions.
- Analytics-backed funnel measurement with Plausible and Stripe Payment Links.
- No fabricated credentials, metrics, or client outcomes.
- No high-risk PII stored on disk.
